 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 4 14-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.
The petitioners have filed the instant application for Patna High Court CWJC No.12000 of 2022(4)
dt.14-03-2023 the following relief(s):
Surendra Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 14 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144772411/
1 "i.

For direction to the respondent Collector to determine the market value of the land in question as per the provisions laid down Under Section 26 of the Right to Fare Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-Settlement Act, 2013 (For brevity Land Acquisition Act, 2013) and to pay the amount of compensation to the petitioners with interest without further delay.
ii.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: For direction to the respondent not to make construction over the raiyati land of the petitioner for the purpose of construction of road connecting to the National H i g h w a y N o . 3 0 f r o m C h e r o - N a g a r n a u s a d i s t r i c t N a l a n d a (Bakhtiyarpur-Kalyanbigha) without following the due process of law and without payment of compensation amount as provided under the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 taking into consideration the value of the land of the petitioners as per the Registration charge fixed by the State Govt. and treating it as the residential/commercial.

iii. For direction to the respondents to pay the damages and compensation to the petitioners with respect to their land over which construction is being done after destroying the crops from the year 2020 itself without any information and consent from the land owners.
iv.
For grant of any other relief or reliefs for which petitioner are entitled in the fact and circumstances of the case."

At the outset, it is submitted by learned counsel Patna High Court CWJC No.12000 of 2022(4)
dt.14-03-2023 appearing for the State that the petitioners have an alternate and efficacious remedy under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Having heard the parties, this writ application is disposed of giving liberty to the petitioners to move before the appropriate authority under the aforesaid Act.
If such an application is filed, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
